shared_elements: row of small repeated signs or motifs along the upper zone
justification: The only real correspondence is structural and generic: both surfaces carry profile relief figures organised beneath an upper zone of small repeated signs and separated by a horizontal band. What is actually depicted differs entirely — A shows schematic animals (quadruped, birds, snake-like forms) with no humans, while B shows human figures at an offering table beneath a rayed disc amid dense columns of writing-like signs.
